SELECT a.id, a.title, a.slug, a.summary, a.cover_image, a.category_id, c.name AS category_name, a.status, a.is_top, a.allow_comment, a.view_count, a.like_count, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM blog_comment bc WHERE bc.article_id = a.id AND bc.status = 1 AND bc.is_deleted = 0 ) AS comment_count, CHAR_LENGTH(a.content) AS word_count, a.publish_time, a.create_time, a.update_time FROM blog_article a LEFT JOIN blog_category c ON c.id = a.category_id AND c.is_deleted = 0
a.is_deleted = 0
AND a.status = 1
AND a.status = #{queryParams.status}
AND a.category_id = #{queryParams.categoryId}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM blog_article_tag bat WHERE bat.article_id = a.id AND bat.tag_id = #{queryParams.tagId} )
AND ( a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryParams.keywords}, '%') OR a.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryParams.keywords}, '%') OR a.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryParams.keywords}, '%') )
